integrated_multimodal_description:
[Shot 1] A woman sits on a traditional wooden stool against a solid crimson red background. She wears a high-quality deep red sleeveless Cheongsam (Qipao) with subtle sheen and precise side slits revealing her legs. She holds a bouquet of pristine white Phalaenopsis orchids in front of her. The camera performs a slow push-in with small amplitude at moderate speed to frame her from the waist up. Lighting is soft, key light + rim light creating gentle shadows and texture on the silk fabric. (S1) says: [Chinese] "新中式上身，尽显东方美韵！"

[Shot 2] At 00:04.000, the camera cuts to a close-up as the woman rises gracefully from the stool, her posture fluid and elegant. The movement of the red silk follows her body perfectly. She gently lifts the orchids slightly, showcasing the delicate white petals contrasting against the crimson dress.

[Shot 3] At 00:07.500, the shot transitions to a medium close-up as she executes a slow, deliberate hand gesture, delicately plucking a single petal from the flower with her fingers. Her expression is serene and joyful, eyes brightening slightly in a half-smile of appreciation for the aesthetic moment.

[Shot 4] At 00:11.000, the camera switches to a three-quarter angle as she continues to pose, extending one arm outward while holding the flowers with the other, fully displaying the silhouette and elegance of her figure. She gazes at the flower in admiration, completing the visual composition of "New Chinese Style."

Negative constraints: No overexposed highlights, no pure black crushed shadows, no sharp aliasing, no cheap plastic reflections, no blurry smooth textures.

overall_soundscape:
Soft fabric rustle as she stands and adjusts posture; delicate rustling sound when handling the orchid petals; subtle ambient room tone without music.

non_diegetic_music:
Ethereal traditional guzheng melody with soft modern synth pad undertones, tempo around 90 BPM, evoking classical Chinese elegance and tranquility to complement the "New Chinese Style" aesthetic.
